about.title: About us
about.body1: Qeedha is a Saudi platform built to simplify running shops and grocery stores - from point of sale to full accounting, in one place, Arabic-first.
about.body2: We believe shop owners deserve simple, powerful tools, without the complexity of traditional accounting systems.
about.missionBody: Empower every Saudi merchant to run their business with confidence, using digital tools compliant with local regulations.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: Our support team is ready to help.

items.q: Does the free trial require a credit card?
items.a: No, you can try Qeedha for a full 14 days without a bank card.

items.q: Are invoices compliant with e-invoicing requirements?
items.a: Yes, every invoice carries a QR code matching the first phase of Saudi e-invoicing.

items.q: Can I upgrade to a different plan later?
items.a: Yes, you can change your plan anytime from the dashboard or by contacting support.

items.q: Does qeedha financing share my accounting data?
items.a: No, qeedha financing is a technically and financially independent product - your accounting data is never merged into it.

items.q: How do I join as an affiliate?
items.a: Register on the Affiliate program page and get your own referral link instantly.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.body: By using the Qeedha platform you agree to these terms. The service is provided "as is", and users are responsible for the accuracy of the data they enter and for compliance with applicable Saudi invoicing and tax regulations. The platform may update these terms, and users are notified of material changes.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We respect the privacy of your data. Your account and business data are used only to operate and improve the service, and are never shared with third parties except to comply with regulations or with your explicit consent. Every user has the right to request a copy of their data or delete their account.
